faq.answer: Payem centralizes all corporate card and vendor spend data onto a single platform, providing an instant, comprehensive view of expenses as they occur. Our AI-powered analytics categorize transactions and flag potential policy violations, eliminating the guesswork and manual tracking often associated with decentralized purchasing across teams and vendors.
faq.question: How does Payem help my finance team gain real-time visibility into company spending?

faq.answer: Payem is designed with deep integration capabilities for QuickBooks Online and Desktop, ensuring a smooth and automated data flow. This integration streamlines your month-end close by automatically syncing transactions, vendor details, and expense categories, significantly reducing manual reconciliation effort and improving accuracy.
faq.question: We use QuickBooks. How seamlessly does Payem integrate with our existing accounting system?

faq.answer: Absolutely. Payem allows you to issue virtual or physical corporate cards with custom spending limits, vendor restrictions, and expiration dates for each employee, department, or project. These granular controls ensure that spending adheres to pre-set budgets and company policies in real-time, preventing overspending before it happens.
faq.question: Can Payem help us control spending and enforce budgets across different departments or projects?

faq.answer: Payem offers dedicated Vendor Virtual Cards, which are ideal for managing recurring subscriptions and one-off vendor payments. You can issue unique cards for each vendor, set specific spending limits, and easily track all associated expenses, providing better control and visibility while simplifying reconciliation and preventing duplicate payments.
faq.question: How does Payem simplify the process of managing vendor payments and subscriptions?

faq.answer: Payem is built to support scaling businesses from 50 to 500+ employees, offering a robust platform that adapts as your team and vendor footprint expand. Our multi-card program platform allows you to effortlessly issue and manage cards for new hires, teams, and an increasing number of vendors, ensuring your spend management processes remain efficient and controlled during periods of rapid growth.
faq.question: We're a growing company with increasing headcount. How does Payem scale with our needs?

faq.answer: Customers typically see significant ROI through reduced operational costs, increased efficiency, and minimized spend leakage. This is achieved by automating manual tasks, enforcing spend policies, eliminating paper receipts, reducing reconciliation time, and providing actionable insights that help identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize procurement.
